Hi Laura — thanks for the clear ask. I put together a compact MAP + acceptance suite below and attached the working workbook (HealthSync_MAP_Q2_v3.xlsx) plus a short markdown containing acceptance test scripts (acceptance-tests.md). Summary here so procurement/security have the key numbers at a glance.

MAP summary (2-week pilot, suggested dates July 6–20):
- Week 0 (preflight, owners: HealthSync Product / Redwood SE): credentials, VPC routing test, sample dataset ingestion (3 sample batches).
- Week 1 (integration smoke + experiments, owners: HealthSync Eng / Redwood Infra): run smoke tests, run 3 experiment buckets (canonical prompts, domain prompts, adversarial edge cases).
- Week 2 (acceptance verification + signoffs, owners: HealthSync Product / Redwood CS): execute acceptance tests, gather traces, hand off evidence. Decision by EOD Fri week 2.

Acceptance tests (objective & pass/fail):
1) Functional concordance (core workflow): concordance >= 0.88 on labeled sample (N=400) using our evaluation harness. Failure: < 0.82 -> automatic revert to baseline model and stop further traffic.
2) Latency SLO: p95 generation latency < 240ms for 99% of requests at expected load (500 concurrent small requests). Failure: sustained p95 > 350ms for 10+ minutes -> escalate and failfast.
3) Cost per completed transaction: average token cost per final response <= $0.015 under pilot batching settings. Failure: > $0.03 -> propose quantized model variant for pilot continuation.
4) Safety / hallucination sentinel: auto-checks for hallucination on 50 golden prompts; false positive rate <= 5%. Failure: >10% -> require remediation and re-run.
5) Stability: KV cache hit rate >= 60% and no OOM/worker restarts during 48-hour soak. Failure: any crash logs -> abort and run postmortem with root-cause owner.

Experimentation notes (what we'll measure):
- A/B: FP32 baseline vs int8-quant variant for cost/latency/accuracy tradeoffs.
- Batching profiles: 1, 4, 8-request batch widths to find knee for p95.
- Prefix caching: measure percent of reused KV per user cohort and impact on token counts.

Exit gates / rollback triggers (explicit):
- Immediate rollback: any data leak or PII exfiltration discovered in logs / responses (stop, revoke keys, initiate incident response).
- Performance rollback: See latency failures above.
- Quality rollback: If concordance < 0.82 or hallucination > 10% on sentinel set.

Evidence & artifacts we will deliver:
- Evidence bundle: sample requests/responses (anonymized), p95/p50 metrics, token-cost breakdown, trace links.
- Acceptance sheet: per-test pass/fail with owner signoff (attached).

Next steps (this week):
- I uploaded the MAP workbook with owners and timelines. Please confirm the pilot window and that HealthSync can provide the labeled concordance set by June 30.

If ok, I'll add a DocuSign for the pilot order (2-week reserved capacity window) and loop in CS/Security for the data handling checklist.

Thanks — Markus

--
Markus Klein

I'll prepare the SRE artifact template and ping Laura for the concordance set delivery ETA.

-priyom
